mapper.select: SELECT tpl.TPL_SEQ tplSeq , tpl.TPL_NAME tplName , FN_GET_COMM_CODE_DESC('TPL_PHASE', tpl.TPL_PHASE) tplPhase FROM TB_EXER_TPL tpl INNER JOIN TB_EXER exer ON tpl.TPL_SEQ = exer.TPL_SEQ INNER JOIN TB_EXER_ATTR attr ON exer.TPL_ATTR_SEQ = attr.TPL_ATTR_SEQ WHERE tpl.USE_YN = 'Y' AND tpl.DEL_YN = 'N' AND attr.TPL_TYPE_CODE = #{tplTypeCode} GROUP BY tpl.TPL_SEQ ORDER BY tpl.SORT_ORDER

SELECT tpl.TPL_SEQ tplSeq , tpl.TPL_NAME tplName , FN_GET_COMM_CODE_DESC('TPL_PHASE', tpl.TPL_PHASE) tplPhase FROM TB_EXER_TPL tpl WHERE tpl.TPL_SEQ = #{tplSeq} AND tpl.USE_YN = 'Y' AND tpl.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT attr.TPL_ATTR_SEQ tplAttrSeq , attr.TPL_TYPE_CODE tplTypeCode , attr.TPL_EXER_NAME tplExerName , FN_GET_COMM_CODE_DESC('TPL_CATEGORY', attr.TPL_CATEGORY_CODE) tplCategoryCode , FN_GET_COMM_CODE_DESC('TPL_KIND_CODE', attr.TPL_KIND_CODE) tplKindCode , attr.TPL_NOTE tplNote , attr.TPL_SORT_ORDER tplSortOrder FROM TB_EXER exer JOIN TB_EXER_ATTR attr ON exer.TPL_ATTR_SEQ = attr.TPL_ATTR_SEQ WHERE exer.TPL_SEQ = #{tplSeq} AND attr.USE_YN = 'Y' AND attr.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY attr.TPL_SORT_ORDER
